concepts.name: First Light Immersion
concepts.prompt:
Design one polished desktop homepage screenshot for OREGON FISH FORECAST, 1440x1920 (3:4). Edge-to-edge UI, no browser/device frame or concept board. Reference 1: existing site's content and palette; redesign its layout. Reference 2: River Country logos; use C2 Timberline fish silhouette with snow peak, pines, river and gold sun eye as compact header logo. Wordmark OREGON / FISH FORECAST.

Palette: blue #002A86, gold #FFEA0F, evergreen #285D45, paper #F5F2E9, white #FFFEF8. DM Sans, bold headings, readable 16px body, generous whitespace, restrained borders, no nested cards. Header links: The waters / River conditions / Our approach. Small CENTRAL OREGON PILOT label.

Only Lower Deschutes has a conditions page; reach Warm Springs to Trout Creek, reach review in progress. Other rivers are Proposed coverage. Primary CTA: Explore the Lower Deschutes. No invented readings, scores, live badges, guarantees, testimonials or accounts. No data charts. Regional scenery only; no specific access claims. Date anchor Oct 7, 2026; omit dates.

PHOTO-LED IMMERSIVE DESIGN. Top 850px full-width cinematic autumn river photo: blue water, ponderosa pines, high-desert cliffs, dawn light. Dark evergreen shade supports white masthead and huge left-aligned white headline 'Know the water.' then gold 'Make the day.' Short supporting copy, gold pill CTA. Slim value strip: Measured river conditions / Source-linked weather / Clear sources. Honest limits.

Below, warm paper 'Find your water.' section. Left two-thirds: generous Lower Deschutes feature with photo detail, exact reach, First conditions page, Reach review in progress. Right: three fine-rule rows Crooked River, Metolius River, Fall River, each Proposed coverage. Finish with blue footer, The source matters, Our approach. Premium outdoor editorial character, carefully aligned, natural photography and clear hierarchy.
